 OCCUPATION: DISTRIBUTOR R/O BHOYAS POST  NANDYAL P.S. JARIF NAGAR JANPAD BADAUN  DISTRICT BADAUN (UTTAR PRADESH)

 (BY SHRI MANOJ KUSHWAHA - PANEL LAWYER )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.254/2023, dated 02.07.2023 registered at Police Station-Saman,
District-Rewa (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 419, 420 of IPC and Section 66-C & 66-D of the Information Technology Act.

Applicant is in detention since 18.10.2023.
2.

As per the prosecution story, o n 02.07.2023, complainant Kailash Chandra Awadiya lodged FIR stating that he is posted as Principal in Government Boys' Higher Secondary School (C.M. Rise school), Mangawa.

sentences.text: His bank account bearing a/c no.30538496526 is in State Bank of India, PBB Branch, Rewa.
On 20.04.2023, he received a phone call from mobile number 7037599204 on his mobile; the person who had made the call introduced himself as Sanjay Shukla, HDB Bank, Branch Gwalior.

He informed that he has forwarded some documents through Whatsapp; he may go through the documents and can obtain a loan of Rs.20,00,000/- in PDL scheme and the interest of the loan Firoz Alam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83966112/

He accepted the proposal and sent copies of his Aadhar card, PAN card,
Bank Statements, Salary slips etc. through Whatsapp.
He was told that Vimal Bhatnagar from phone number 7895749106 shall verify the papers.
When he made a call on Vimal Bhatnagar's mobile number, he sent HBD-Apk App through Whatsapp and instructed him to install the same in mobile and directed to fill up the form sent through App.
Believing him, he filled all the informations in that Apk-App.
It is alleged that on 08.05.2023, personal loan of Rs.9,00,000/- was sanctioned to him and in his account an amount of Rs.8,67,700/- was shown to be transferred.

However, same day,
aforesaid amount was transferred in bank account of Kailash Dhakad in HDFC Bank, Manasa,
Neemach.

On 09.05.2023, an amount of Rs.15,29,893/- sanctioning a personal loan from HDFC Bank was deposited in his account, but out of said amount Rs.10,00,000/- were transferred in the account of Kailash Dhakad and amount of Rs.5,00,000/- in the account of Brajesh Kumar Umre.
As such, he was defrauded and cheated.
FIR was registered.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
The only allegation against him is that of distributing the SIMs to the main accused persons.
Offence is triable by JMFC.
He is in detention for last seven months.
He has no criminal background.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail as co-accused Rahul Dev Sharma has already been released on bail.
4 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, detention period of the applicant, and the fact that co-accused has already been released on bail and final conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . It is directed that applicant - Firoz Alam be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Firoz Alam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83966112/
